sources.title: AASB 116 Property, Plant and Equipment
sources.fact: Recognition, depreciation and component-accounting requirements come from the compilation operative for the reporting period.

sources.title: Income Tax Assessment Act 1997
sources.fact: Division 40 separates tax decline in value and effective-life choices from the management-accounting machine rate. Read 28 October 2026 in compilation C2026C00471 (compilation 268, in force from 1 October 2026): Act No. 86, 2026, Sch 2 item 5 changed Division 40 only by using the defined term real property in s 40-27(4)(c)(ii); Act No. 71, 2026, Sch 2 replaced the $1,000 thresholds in Subdiv 328-D with $20,000, applying as set out in its item 15.
